newsitem.title: USA: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow Jones average drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late morning trading Wednesday after the government said that a jump in productivity at U.S. businesses in the first quarter allowed workers to enjoy a big rise in wages.
At 11:19 a.m. EDT, the Dow was off 50.57 points at 7,174.74, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limit on program trading.
